title: Processing job
description: One attempt to turn a recording into the followed game video, in the cloud or on the user's own computer. The API keeps this record (docs/API.md, "Processing jobs") and returns it to the website and the apps. A cloud job passes through queued, preparing, needs_answers, (refitting, needs_answers)*, queued, running, done. A local job is written by the app that runs it.

where.description: cloud: AWS Batch. local: the user's own computer (the Mac app).

status.description: queued: waiting for a machine. preparing: the engine's prepare command. needs_answers: waiting for the user to answer the checks. refitting: redoing a check from the user's answer. running: the engine's run command. done, failed and cancelled are final.

phase.description: Which half the job is in: up to the checks, or after them. Tells the two queued states apart.

checks.description: The checks the user answers between prepare and run. The run starts when both are answered.

code.description: The engine's error code (footage_corrupt, not_enough_disk, ...), or one of the server's: engine_failed, engine_no_result, machine_failed, no_machine, timed_out, superseded.

stale.description: True when the recording became ready again after this job started (a second phone's footage arrived): the job did not see all the footage.

engineVersion.description: The engine that ran it, as the engine names itself (a version and commit).

stage.description: What the engine is doing, e.g. sync, pitch, kits, ball, render, upload.

fraction.description: How far through the current command (prepare or run), not the stage.
